requirement: v2.2.3: a fleet target that enables remote desktop serves repeated encrypted view frames to an online viewer at a one-second cadence, over P2P when available and the encrypted relay frame channel otherwise

assertions.capture: test/view-capture.test.mjs 4/4: unsupported platform, macOS capture, spawnSync status, and the transport size refusal
assertions.p2p: test/view-frame-channel.test.mjs 4/4: consent denial, handshake, repeated frames at the configured interval, and input-frame refusal
assertions.consent: test/view-consent.test.mjs 4/4: default deny, local enable, localside/ parent fallback, and W2M_VIEW_ALLOW overrides
assertions.relay: test/relay-target.test.mjs 3/3: first sealed frame, repeated frames at the interval, and no request consumption while consent is off
assertions.viewer: test/remote-view-route.test.mjs 3/3: P2P session, P2P refusal, and a fresh relay frame on each 1 Hz poll
assertions.client: test/client-bundle.test.mjs 36/36: the client bundle still loads with the remote-view settings and page copy
assertions.loader: test/loader-entry.test.mjs 10/10 against the packed 2.2.3 tarball in the real DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 Loader and Edge page
assertions.capture_timing: local Windows real-capture relay stream produced 3 frames at 1.067 s, 2.087 s and 3.123 s (1.02-1.06 s cadence); the fast helper itself measured 0.23-0.40 s after compilation
assertions.scope: local code and tests only; no installed profile was edited by the tests; release is published separately
